valLoss.source: train.py: cross-entropy on 1,966,956 held-out characters (TinyStoriesV2-GPT4-valid.txt), windows of 128, CPU fp32

trainChars.source: train.py: ak.data.tinystories_chars(n_chars=40,000,000) on the TinyStories train head (story markers become blank lines), normalized

evalChars.source: units.py: first 400,000 characters of TinyStoriesV2-GPT4-valid.txt, windows of 128

counterUnit.source: units.py: largest correlation of c with the letters so far in the word

counterResetF.unit: median forget gate at a space after a letter

counterLetterF.unit: median forget gate at a letter after a letter

counterRise.unit: median change of c per letter inside a word

quoteR.unit: largest |Pearson r| of any unit's c or h with 'a quote is open'

quoteChars.unit: quote marks in the held-out text

medianF.unit: median forget gate, all units and characters

meanF.unit: mean forget gate, all units and characters
